## Activity

During July 2023, Central Eye Clinic recorded 151 captures. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The volume provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes across the reporting period. Activity was recorded through the clinic’s usual operational processes, with captures submitted for subsequent assessment.

## Image quality

Of the 151 captures, 2 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.3. These images could not be used for grading and were excluded from assessment of referable findings. The result should continue to be monitored as part of routine quality review.

## Grading

Grading identified 38 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 2. This provides an indication of the time taken for images to progress through the grading process during July 2023. The findings should be considered alongside the capture volume and image-quality result when reviewing site performance.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.
